registration: Metadata discovery already inspected; registered before any new velocity payload download, fitting or favorable-result inspection. Existing J09 results are prior evidence, not prospective tests.

reference.meaning: Point Clear NOAA station reference, not owner pier coordinates

geometry_screen.rationale: Prospective discovery screen (~37% closer than prior track), analyst design choice, not proof of hydrodynamic representativeness. Other Eastern Shore sites require separately versioned target coordinates and geometry; no substitution.
geometry_screen.required: Same shoreline cell and connected shallow-water pathway, surveyed bed and sample-volume position; distance alone cannot pass.

acceptance.other_qc_flags: 2 not evaluated, 3 suspect, 4 fail, 9 missing are not accepted; raw rows preserved
acceptance.missing_rows: UNKNOWN; never zero current or no event
acceptance.orientation_test: Known north/east/south/west vector fixtures and independent compass alignment check; direction-to clockwise from true north; u=speed*sin(theta), v=speed*cos(theta). No course-over-ground substitution for heading.
acceptance.depth_test: Reject dry/buried/obstructed samples and ADCP cells intersecting vendor blanking or surface/bed sidelobe masks; depth=0 mirror metadata is not bottom clearance.
acceptance.timing_test: UTC offset documented; monotonic per deployment, duplicate timestamps reconciled, clock error <=30 s; observed/available/ingested timestamps retained separately.
acceptance.minimum_validation_window: 14 consecutive deployment days, >=90% expected 5-minute records after QC, no accepted gap >15 min; each represented dawn reported separately. These are provisional research design criteria, not evidence of predictive skill.
acceptance.skill_gate: No event fitting in this source audit. Separate preregistered, episode/day-blocked held-out loading-only/transport-only/combined comparison with verified positives and Tier-A scoped controls and availability-time cutoff is required; currently not estimable.

local_sensor_design_targets.averaging: Archive native bursts; log burst rate/duration/count and average method; tune device-specific sampling before acquisition, retain wave variability.
local_sensor_design_targets.geometry: Survey before installation; actual sampling volume must stay submerged at ordinary low water and clear sediment/piling wakes. A point meter can close local bottom-vector gap; profile or second level is needed to infer vertical transport/shear.
local_sensor_design_targets.telemetry: Unattended shore-powered/Wi-Fi or autonomous logger, local buffer and backfill; no routine manual predawn work.
local_sensor_design_targets.maintenance: Daylight retrievable service/calibration, initially every 7-14 days in summer; adapt interval to documented fouling/drift.
local_sensor_design_targets.limitations: Design targets, not vendor specifications or a purchase approval. DO/salinity/temperature kit alone does not measure currents; budget feasibility unverified.
